housing.text: As a county commissioner, he advocated for more than 1,000 affordable housing units.
housing.quote: As a Broward County Commissioner, he advocated for over 1,000 new affordable housing units throughout the county.

health.text: He supports strengthening the Affordable Care Act and moving toward Medicare for All to guarantee coverage.
health.quote: he supports moving toward a Medicare for All system that guarantees coverage to every American

tax.text: Singer says he would keep taxes and costs low and reports voting to lower Boca Raton’s tax rate.
tax.quote: As Congressman, he will keep taxes and costs low, and ensure strong borders and national defense.

debt.text: He supports cutting government spending to reduce the national debt.
debt.quote: We must rein in the size and scope of the federal government, eliminate waste and fraud, and cut spending.

safety.text: He says that as mayor he increased investment in public safety and police staffing.
safety.quote: As mayor, Scott has consistently increased investment to ensure the best in public safety.

immigration.text: He calls for securing the borders, stopping illegal immigration, and cooperating with federal immigration authorities.
immigration.quote: The U.S. is a nation of laws, and our immigration system must prioritize national security. We must secure our borders and stop illegal immigration.

guns.text: He says gun restrictions should be limited to convicted felons and people found through due process to be active threats.
guns.quote: Restrictions should be limited to convicted felons and those proven through due process to be active threats.

abortion.text: He supports legal protection for human life from conception, with stated exceptions for rape, incest, and protecting the mother’s life.
abortion.quote: Human life deserves legal protection from conception until natural death.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He supports excluding biological males from women’s sports and women’s spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison.

health.text: He said Medicare, Medicaid, and VA care should remain available but that no additional taxpayer-funded health programs are needed.
health.quote: Medicaid and Medicare and VA care for veterans should remain available, but we need to end waste, fraud, and abuse

energy.text: He supports prioritizing natural gas and nuclear power over mandated wind and solar energy.
energy.quote: To meet electricity demands and ensure grid stability, we must unleash American energy by prioritizing natural gas and nuclear power.

voting.text: He supports photo identification and says he will push for strict photo ID and proof-of-citizenship requirements.
voting.quote: I will strongly push to pass the SAVE America Act to mandate strict photo ID and proof of citizenship.
